mapper.insert: INSERT INTO desktop_task ( task_id, conversation_id, url, status, created_at, approval_expires_at, approved_at, finished_at, result_code, result_summary ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{conversationId}, #{url}, #{status}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{approvalExpiresAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{approvedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{finishedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{resultCode}, #{resultSummary} )
mapper.update: UPDATE desktop_task SET status = #{status}, approved_at = #{approvedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, finished_at = #{finishedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, result_code = #{resultCode}, result_summary = #{resultSummary} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, conversation_id, url, status, created_at, approval_expires_at, approved_at, finished_at, result_code, result_summary FROM desktop_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
